<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.002.001.12">
  <FIToFIPmtStsRpt>
    <GrpHdr>
      <MsgId>{{randomValue length=36 type='ALPHANUMERIC'}}</MsgId>
      <CreDtTm>{{now format='yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\''}}</CreDtTm>
      <InstgAgt>
        <FinInstnId>
          <BICFI>SWIFTNET</BICFI>
        </FinInstnId>
      </InstgAgt>
      <InstdAgt>
        <FinInstnId>
          <BICFI>{{jsonPath '$.request.body'}}</BICFI>
        </FinInstnId>
      </InstdAgt>
    </GrpHdr>
    <OrgnlGrpInfAndSts>
      <OrgnlMsgId>{{jsonPath '$.request.body'}}</OrgnlMsgId>
      <OrgnlMsgNmId>pacs.008.001.08</OrgnlMsgNmId>
      <OrgnlCreDtTm>{{now format='yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\''}}</OrgnlCreDtTm>
    </OrgnlGrpInfAndSts>
    <TxInfAndSts>
      <StsId>{{randomValue length=36 type='ALPHANUMERIC'}}</StsId>
      <OrgnlTxId>{{jsonPath '$.request.body'}}</OrgnlTxId>
      <TxSts>ACSC</TxSts>
      <StsRsnInf>
        <Orgtr>
          <Nm>SWIFT Network</Nm>
        </Orgtr>
        <Rsn>
          <Cd>NARR</Cd>
          <Prtry>SWIFT message successfully processed and delivered</Prtry>
        </Rsn>
      </StsRsnInf>
      <ChrgsInf>
        <Amt>
          <InstdAmt Ccy="{{jsonPath '$.request.body'}}">0.00</InstdAmt>
        </Amt>
        <Agt>
          <FinInstnId>
            <BICFI>SWIFTNET</BICFI>
          </FinInstnId>
        </Agt>
      </ChrgsInf>
      <AccptncDtTm>{{now format='yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\''}}</AccptncDtTm>
      <AcctSvcrRef>{{randomValue length=20 type='ALPHANUMERIC'}}</AcctSvcrRef>
      <ClrSysRef>{{randomValue length=16 type='ALPHANUMERIC'}}</ClrSysRef>
    </TxInfAndSts>
    <SplmtryData>
      <PlcAndNm>SWIFT</PlcAndNm>
      <Envlp>
        <Any>
          <swift:MessageInfo xmlns:swift="urn:swift:xsd:swift">
            <swift:MessageType>MT103</swift:MessageType>
            <swift:MessagePriority>N</swift:MessagePriority>
            <swift:DeliveryMonitoring>1</swift:DeliveryMonitoring>
            <swift:ObsolescencePeriod>003</swift:ObsolescencePeriod>
          </swift:MessageInfo>
        </Any>
      </Envlp>
    </SplmtryData>
  </FIToFIPmtStsRpt>
</Document>
